result.summary: Found two potential usability issues: low-contrast navigation labels and content that does not match the selected category.

issues.description: The inactive bottom-navigation icons and labels are light gray on white, making them difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker gray that meets contrast requirements for text and icons.

issues.description: The Pizza category appears selected, but the visible restaurant listings include burgers, poké and ramen.
issues.suggestion: Show pizza-related listings when Pizza is selected, or adjust the selected state to match the displayed content.
